description: This Kotlin source file defines a helper object 'IntentResultBuilder' used for creating 'Instrumentation.ActivityResult' objects for Espresso intent stubbing in Android tests. It provides methods to generate 'OK' and 'Canceled' activity results, simplifying test setup for activities relying on intents.

classes.name: IntentResultBuilder
classes.description: A singleton object providing utility methods to create 'ActivityResult' objects for test stubbing in Espresso tests.

methods.name: ok
methods.description: Creates an 'Instrumentation.ActivityResult' indicating a successful result with optional intent data.

methods.name: canceled
methods.description: Creates an 'Instrumentation.ActivityResult' indicating a canceled result without data.
